''"That is the system. And I'm sure Skywalker is with them. Set your course for the Hoth system.|Darth Vader and Admiral Kendal Ozzel discover Echo Base|audio=VaderAndOzzel-HothSystem.flac|}} '''Echo Base''' was the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] facility established on the frigid [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] after the Rebels were forced to [[Evacuation of Yavin|evacuate]] their previous [[Massassi Site/Legends|base]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. After the Rebels acquired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] data on potential locations for a new base and cold-weather material, [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the Galactic Empire was able to identify the characteristics of the potential base's location, allowing the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to accelerate his discovery of the base. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] crash-landed a [[Rebel smuggling ship|smuggling ship]] on Hoth while fleeing an Imperial blockade, and afterward recommended the planet be the Rebels' new home. This was followed by a recommendation by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]] and the Alliance's [[Habassa]] allies, and [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] thusly chose the frozen world as their new headquarters. Construction of the base was spearheaded by Major Monnon. Monnon's team chose to work with the natural environment, rather than forcing it to conform to their needs, reinforcing, expanding, and connecting existing ice [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] in the [[Clabburn Range/Legends|Clabburn Range]] glacial flow south of the [[Nev Ice Flow/Legends|Nev Ice Flow]]. Rebel equipment initially had issues withstanding Hoth's extremely low temperatures, which forced the Rebels to get creative until engineers could modify their tools to operate in the cold. During construction, the sounds of Rebel technology attracted the local [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] ice beasts, though the creatures were quickly isolated and [[Death/Legends|killed]]. After the base's completion in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Skywalker and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were dispatched from Echo Base on [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] patrol; however, Skywalker did not return, having fallen victim to a [[One-Arm|wampa]] attack. Solo returned to the base alone and informed [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] that he had to leave the Rebellion to address his [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] with [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. While the General respected Solo's decision, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] overheard the conversation, confronted Solo in a hallway and unsuccessfully attempted to persuade him to stay. After realizing the Skywalker had not returned to base, Solo set out on tauntaun to locate his friend, eventually finding him collapsed in the snow. The following morning, [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] were dispatched from Echo Base to locate the two, and the duo was spotted by [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]] and rescued. Shortly after, the Empire discovered Echo Base through a [[Unidentified probe droid (Hoth)|probot]] that landed on Hoth and detected the base's [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]]. Solo and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] counterpart, [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], were sent to investigate, and upon discovering the probe, the Rebels initiated an evacuation. The Empire deployed [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] to the surface to engage the Rebels and destroy the shield generator. Rebel [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]] faced off against Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] while the majority of Rebel forces loaded onto [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] and fled into [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Rebel pilots utilized [[Power harpoon and tow cable/Legends|tow cables]] to trip Imperial [[Walker/Legends|walkers]], making them more vulnerable to [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]]. The shield generator was eventually destroyed, and Vader infiltrated Echo Base, nearly capturing Solo, Organa, their [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], and Chewbacca before the group escaped into the nearby [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. Skywalker managed to escape as well aboard an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] following the destruction of the base, the hunters [[Burrk]], [[Nodon]], and [[Nonak]] set up camp in the base's ruins, funding their expeditions through promotions to big-game hunters. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the wampas, who were the target of the hunts, learned to work together, killing several paying clients of the trio and trapping the hunters in Echo Base. Eventually, Skywalker and [[Callista Ming]] arrived at the base while retracing Skywalker's steps through significant moments in his life, and the two attempted to help the hunters escape. The wampas managed to kill all the hunters, however, before Skywalker noticed the lead wampa was the one he had previously encountered years before and killed her. In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] occupied Echo Base, hoping to locate the planet [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] in the Alliance's old [[Computer core/Legends|computer core]]. They were [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|discovered]] by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jaden Korr]], who destroyed the forces and defeated the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]], though she fled the base. ==Description== Echo Base was built to be the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[High Command Base]]: the hub of all activity by its [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|civil government]] and top military leadership, the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]]. Therefore, the Alliance dedicated considerable resources to planning, building, and defending it. It had space for thousands of personnel and was supplied with the best equipment that the Alliance could procure, though this was not always adequate.[[The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''The Rebel Alliance Sourcebook'', Second Edition]] Echo Base served in this role for about one [[Standard year/Legends|standard year]] before it was evacuated and destroyed.[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)|''Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back'', Second Edition]] The base was located mostly under the surface in the [[Clabburn Range/Legends|Clabburn Range]] of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth's]] northern hemisphere, built in a part of the planet's thick ice sheet where volcanoes and seismic activity had produced a network of caves. The Rebels expanded these natural caverns into a facility large enough to house their forces. This construction took two standard years.''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]'' Deep in the caves, Hoth's volcanic activity produced some natural heat sinks that could be tapped as sources of power, but these were remote and inadequate for Echo Base's needs. Instead the Rebels relied on high-yield [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]]; the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] was the largest structure visible above the surface. Throughout the base's interior, power lines and other equipment were mounted directly into the ice of the walls, giving Echo Base a cluttered, inelegant appearance. This was because it had to be built quickly and ready to take down just as quickly, in case of an emergency evacuation. ===Internal layout=== [[File:Echo_Base_Layout_AoRSR.png|thumb|left|300px|The interior layout of Echo Base]] The base consisted of multiple levels connected by [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] and tunnels. In at least one location, bridges streched over a deep chasm.''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'' Two large bay doors provided main entrances at the north and south ends, opening into the surrounding mountain range. Echo base had two principal [[Hangar/Legends|hangar bays]] and several smaller ones. The main bay, located at the south entrance, was large enough to simultaneously house at least thirty [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. A smaller hangar, [[Hangar 7/Legends|Hangar Bay 7]], was located at the north entrance. Designed to rapidly deploy small craft, it housed one [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-Wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] and one of [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]. The freighter [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] also used this hangar. Bay 7 was protected by a heavy [[shield door]] that was closed each night to seal the base against Hoth's deep cold. Patrols were regularly dispatched through the north entrance. Directly below Hangar Bay 7 was a maintenance level. If a ship needed extensive repairs or modification, it was lowered on a massive lift. Other hangar facilities included [[Bay 3]], used by the freighter [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']] when it smuggled in supplies,[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]] and [[Hangar Ten]], which housed a few starfighters.{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}} The [[Ion Cannon Control]] bunker was connected to its own hangar.''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' In all, the hangars of Echo Base held sixty Rebel Alliance X-Wing and [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing]] starfighters, at least twelve snowspeeders, at least thirty medium transports, six [[Kleeque-class transport|''Kleeque''-class transports]], and several [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]]. The base was not equipped to handle larger [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and while it was occupied, the greater part of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] remained dispersed around [[The galaxy/Legends|the Galaxy]]. [[File:Echo-Base-cutaway-SWCL.png|thumb|right|300px|Echo Base cutaway]] The heart of the base was [[Echo Command Center]], where General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] directed operations across the planet and the surrounding system. Reports and [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] readings came to the command center from [[Echo Station/Legends|Echo Stations]] around the planet's surface. An [[OrC-19 com-scan integrator console]] monitored and integrated sensor data and allowed the general to coordinate the base's defenses.''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]'' Echo Base was equipped with a state-of-the art [[Echo Base medical center/Legends|medical facility]] for healing and rehabilitation. The lab was staffed by hundreds of [[Doctor/Legends|doctors]], specialists, and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]], including [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] and [[FX-7/Legends|FX-7]]. It was equipped with a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]]. Rebels in need of critical treatment were sometimes brought to the medical center from off-world, but in order to preserve secrecy, it was not used as a hospital for the Rebellion at large. Quarters and barracks were spread across several levels and were a mixture of self-contained units and larger caverns, both natural and engineered. Some quarters were set aside for [[Officer/Legends|officers]], in-transit personnel, and VIPs. All quarters were subject to extreme cold, and most contained only a bunk, storage space, and daily necessities. Near the hangars, the base held pens for the [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntauns]] used as mounts for scouting missions. Some spaces were equipped with heavy [[Deflector shield/Legends|shielding]] and used as impromptu pens for [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] creatures that had invaded the base; these rooms were marked with bright red and yellow warning signs, nicknamed "do not disturb signs" by the personnel. Echo Base was equipped with sophisticated machine shops that, given enough time, could produce just about any piece of equipment that the Rebels could require. Briefing and meeting rooms of different sizes could be found around the facility. They included one large auditorium with fixed seating. ===Defenses=== [[File:SoR_Chpt_IV_Modular_Encounters.png|thumb|right|180px|The Alliance patrolled around Echo base on tauntaun mounts.]] Echo Base's outermost defenses were its squadrons of starfighters, which conducted patrols of the outer [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]]. On Hoth itself, the Alliance constructed defensive structures on a planetary scale: a massive [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]], an OrC-19 planetary com-scan unit, and a [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shield]]. The ion cannon was operated from a dedicated Ion Cannon Control by an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] crew. The planetary shield, produced by a powerful [[DSS-02 shield generator/Legends|DSS-02 shield generator]] installed on Hoth's surface, was strong enough to block any [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] and made it impossible for enemy ships to land near the base. At the same time, while activated it prevented ships from leaving the planet. To watch for threats both from the surface and from above, Scout posts labeled "[[Echo Station/Legends|Echo Stations]]" dotted a considerable area of the planet. [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]] was the most distant of these stations; others included [[Echo Station 3-8]], [[Echo Station 3-T-8/Legends|Echo Station 3-T-8]], [[Echo Station 5-7/Legends|Echo Station 5-7]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' Imperial Campaign and other [[sentry marker]]s.[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' novelization]] Scouts mounted on tauntauns patrolled the area between the base and the stations and beyond. Work was underway on a network of warning sensors covering the entire region.{{ESBRadio|Freedom's Winter}} Trusting the planetary shield to block attacks from above, the Rebels of Echo Base expected any Imperial attack to come along the surface. The base itself was therefore surrounded and covered by a large network of ground defenses. Interconnected trenches gave cover to troopers beneath larger guns: anti-vehicle [[1.4 FD P-Tower/Legends|1.4 FD P-Towers]] and anti-infantry [[DF.9/Legends|DF.9 cannons]]. Neither type of cannon was particularly powerful, but they were available to the Rebel Alliance and hardy enough to function in Hoth's climate. A shipment of more powerful anti-vehicle [[v-188 Penetrator]]s was delayed and unavailable to the base when the Imperial attack came.{{JournalCite|9|Repulsortank Battlefield}} Fortified outbuildings included a [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] and bunkers connected to the base.''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'' The ion cannon was protected by its own trenches and anti-material [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'' connected to the main base by a tunnel.''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' ===Interactive map=== {{MapBox|mapname=Echo Base/Legends|file=Echo-Base-cutaway-SWCL.png|source=[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]}} ==History== ===Rebels on thin ice=== {{Quote|The ice planet seemed a terrible option, a horrendously difficult place to establish living quarters...but it was also a place where the Empire would never suspect us. That was more important than our personal comfort. Besides, we could always wear thermal mittens and bring extra blankets.|Major Kem Monnon|}} [[File:Luke_discovers_hoth.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Luke Skywalker crashes on Hoth while fleeing Imperial forces.]] After the Rebel Alliance's victory at the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]{{Film|IV}} in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Massassi Site/Legends|Rebel base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] was [[Evacuation of Yavin|destroyed]], and the Alliance scrambled to find a new location from which to base their operations. High Command dispatched a commando team to gather further information on potential bases, and eight [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after the Battle of Yavin, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] helped the team infiltrate an Imperial data station to compile a list of planets that met the desired criteria: worlds that were currently uninhabited but contained existing facilities, such as abandoned mining complexes.''[[Choices of One]]'' Soon after, [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken's]] mission to [[Poln Major]] acquired for the Alliance a wealth of cold-weather material, [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] equipment, and a dozen [[Snowspeeder/Legends|combat-modified airspeeders]]. However, the distinctiveness of the equipment later allowed [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to identify the rebel base's planetary characteristics, enabling [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] to narrow down the possible locations for his search and thus, in conjunction with General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Veers's]] discovery that the base was located somewhere near the [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood System]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' greatly accelerate his discovery of the base. The first Rebel to visit Hoth itself was Luke Skywalker, who then held the rank of [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]], together with the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]. To escape an Imperial blockade, he rode the [[hyperstream]] of a trans-dimensional comet, which crash-landed his [[Rebel smuggling ship|smuggling ship]] on Hoth's surface. After escaping a pair of stranded [[Human replica droid]]s, Skywalker suggested the Alliance use Hoth as their next haven."[[Iceworld]]" Besides Skywalker, Rebel [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]], who had a history of collecting information on tramp space [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] before joining the Rebels, offered his own suggestions, placing a particular emphasis on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. After further recommendation by their [[Habassa]] allies,[[Star Wars: X-Wing (video game)|''Star Wars: X-Wing'']] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] was persuaded to select Hoth as a suitable location for the base.{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Plan for the Future}} [[File:ClabburnRange-ESB.png|thumb|right|300px|Echo Base was constructed within the caverns of Clabburn Range.]] To better examine Hoth, the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]] established a small outpost on the world to evaluate the potential of building a larger base.{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|cardname=Building the Base}} Although the outpost came under [[Battle of Hoth (2 ABY)|attack]] by a small Imperial force, the Special Forces successfully defended it, and no Imperials remained alive to report the base's existence.{{SWGTCG|set=The Nightsister's Revenge|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}} A reconnaissance and survey team was dispatched to Hoth on a low-[[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] [[Map/Legends|mapping]] expedition to scout for possible locations for the new Rebel headquarters. Geothermal analysis indicated that the best location for the base was on the northern edge of the only livable temperate band near the equator, where seismic and volcanic activity had cracked the thick ice sheet, creating vast networks of caverns. The team discovered a series of ice [[Cave/Legends|caverns]] inside the primeval glacial flow{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040325web|text=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin|int=Galactic Gazetteer: Hoth and the Greater Javin}} known as the [[Clabburn Range/Legends|Clabburn Range]] south of the [[Nev Ice Flow/Legends|Nev Ice Flow]]. The same cavern system had once attracted the smugglers [[Jonox Forb]] and, more recently, [[Salmakk]].{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20031204hoth|text=Hoth: Under the Ice|int=Hoth: Under the Ice}} Monnon knew they had found their new home. ===In frigid fraternity=== {{Quote|Instead of marching in and converting the surface of the planet to our own needs, as the Empire would have done, we tried to work with the environment of a world not considered habitable by humanoid life-forms.|Major Kem Monnon|}} [[File:Kem_Helmet.png|thumb|left|250px|Major Kem Monnon of the Alliance Corps of Engineers led the construction of Echo Base.]] Rather than force the planet's surface to conform to their needs, Monnon's team worked with the natural environment of Hoth, despite its inhospitableness. Using the natural resources instead of shipping in huge cargoes of supplies and prefabricated structures also served as a military tactic, allowing for greater efficiency and leaving minimal traces of activity on the surface. While they waited for the rest of the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] to arrive, surveyors mapped the labyrinths of ice, probing far underground where the sunlight only managed to penetrate the ice in the form of a dim, rainbow-like glow. The scouts located solid rock inclusions and lava tubes that released steam that froze into giant sulfur-and-ice stalactites, which they tapped into as a power source. However, Monnon considered them too far beneath the surface to serve as the base proper. The idea of being trapped that far down during an attack also made the major uneasy. Monnon's engineers reinforced, expanded, and connected the natural ice caverns beneath the surface, using [[LC-10bW]]''[[Star Wars Blueprints: Rebel Edition]]'' [[Laser/Legends|laser]] ice [[Laser cutter/Legends|cutters]], excavation machinery, and, when necessary, hand-operated [[vibrospade]]s. The team ran power conduits and communications tubes along the walls of ice and packed snow. The Rebels' equipment initially struggled to withstand the extreme temperatures, failing frequently and forcing engineers to rely on staff to deliver messages in person. Lesser functionaries and runners carried recordings from deep tunnel excavations to the upper command centers and back, processing supply requisitions from matériel ships or requesting design and computer assistance form the fleet's other specialists. Eventually, Rebel technicians became adept at altering the equipment to better endure the cold climate. During the construction process, the Alliance cleared the base of [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] ice creatures, though they continued to be a threat throughout the Rebel occupation. When a wampa entered the base, usually attracted by the sounds of Rebel technology, it was quickly isolated and [[Death/Legends|dispatched]] by the base's troops. Up on the surface, [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jobin]] led the soldiers of [[4th Squad]] in setting up perimeter defenses over many [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]].{{StoryCite|story=Entrenched|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}} [[File:Wampa_Echo_Base.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Wampas occasionally attacked Rebel soldiers on Echo Base.]] The base became partially operational before construction was complete. It was put to work staging limited operations and dispatches. Some early operations were meant as diversions: false scouting missions to make it appear that the Alliance was searching elsewehere for a base. Other missions secured resources for the base, such as a [[Reconnaissance mission to Ord Mantell|mission to Ord Mantell]] organized by Princess Leia to steal back part of the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa family]] fortune.''[[Rebel Mission to Ord Mantell]]'' The High Command came to Echo Base despite its unfinished state and complications from the cold. The climate hindered all operations in the new base, including the most routine. The staff were trained in surviving sub-zero temperatures and issued adverse weather gear. Supplies of this necessary gear were constantly short, delaying crucial work like adapting the fleet of [[T-47 airspeeder/Legends|T-47 speeders]] to the cold. These shortages only grew worse when an urgently-needed supply convoy, together with its fighter escorts of [[Renegade Flight]], was [[Battle of Derra IV|ambushed and destroyed]] near the planet [[Derra IV/Legends|Derra IV]]. After this loss, the personnel of Echo Base had to make do with less, and Luke Skywalker, promoted to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|Commander]], took charge of readying the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]] and pilots of his own [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]]. Most Echo Base personnel were focused on construction; even the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech]] droid R2-D2 was reassigned to digging duty. However, even in this early stage, some Rebels dispatched operations throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Though Hoth's remoteness offered a tactical advantage, it left the crew themselves feeling isolated. With no [[City/Legends|cities]] to relax in, Rebel soldiers had to find their own sources of entertainment. At one point, C-3PO and his companion, R2-D2, due to a misunderstanding between the two, ended up activating the thermal heaters inside Princess Leia's chambers, causing the room to partially melt, ruining Princess Leia's wardrobe in the process.''[[Meltdown on Hoth]]'' Both were given a stern reprimand by the base's stuffy coordinator [[Droid/Legends|droid]], [[K-3PO/Legends|K-3PO]]. ===The locals strike back=== {{Quote|Your Highness, there's nothing more we can do tonight. The shield doors must be closed.|Major Bren Derlin, to Leia Organa following the disappearances of Luke Skywalker and Han Solo|}} In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Skywalker and Solo rode on a tauntaun patrol outside the base to place [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] to scan for life signs. Skywalker spotted what he believed to be a meteorite crashing—in actuality an [[Unidentified probe droid (Hoth)|Imperial probe droid]], one of thousands of [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probes]] searching for the Rebels—and stayed behind to investigate while Solo returned to Echo Base. An [[Unidentified wampa/Legends|angry wampa]] attacked him and dragged him to a [[Wampa cave/Legends|cave]]. Luke regained consciousness and used his lightsaber to escape, cutting off the arm of the cave's [[One-Arm|other wampa inhabitant]]. He was free of the creature but injured and lost as night closed in. Solo returned to Echo Base alone. He went immediately to [[Hangar 7/Legends|Hangar Bay 7]] to check on his first mate [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca's]] progress in repairing the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. He next went to the command center to inform General [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] that he had decided to leave the Alliance. He had an outstanding [[Death mark/Legends|death mark]] and wanted to settle his debt to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] before it killed him. The general respected his decision, but Leia Organa, who overheard, followed Solo into the [[south passage]] to confront him. As other Rebels shuffled past them, she unsuccessfully tried to persuade him to stay with the Rebels. He retorted that she only wanted him to stay because of her feelings for him. Their argument escalated to shouting, and Solo stormed off. [[File:AlderLeia-ESB.png|thumb|right|250px|Bren Derlin informs Leia Organa that the base's shield doors will be closed overnight.]] Solo returned to the hangar to continue repairs on the ''Millennium Falcon'' with Chewbacca. Meanwhile, Organa realized that she had not heard from Skywalker. She tried to call Solo; when he ignored her, she sent C-3PO and R2-D2 to find him. Solo had [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]] [[Tamizander Rey]]{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Tamizander Rey}} see whether Skywalker had checked into the base, either through the north or the south entrance. When he still could not be located, Solo resolved to go find him. The speeders were still not adapted to function in a Hoth night, so he had to rode out on a tauntaun, ignoring Rey's warning that it would freeze to death. As the night grew darker, R2-D2 continued operating his scanners near the entrance in the hopes of detecting either Skywalker or Solo. Finally Major [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] reported that they had to close the shield doors for the night. As they slammed shut, Chewbacca growled in despair, and C-3PO tried without success to reassure Organa. [[File:Bacta_Tank.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker recovers in the medical center, watched by his friends.]] Solo found Skywalker injured and barely conscious. He kept him warm overnight, using the carcass of his dead tauntaun and an [[emergency shelter]].{{ESBRadio|The Coming Storm}} The following morning, [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] flew out from Echo Base in snowspeeders, and [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]], [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]], located the two survivors. They returned to Echo Base, where Skywalker was placed in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] in the medical center to recover. Rieekan now ordered Solo to remain at the base. He believed it was too dangerous for any Rebel ships to depart the Hoth system. Skywalker recovered with his friends by his side. Solo and Organa broke into another argument over their romantic feelings; she put an end to it when she kissed Skywalker to make Solo jealous. The attack put the Echo Base personnel on edge, fearful of more wampas that might be lurking in or around the base. Derlin ordered regular patrols of the base's perimeter. Scouts had always been sent out in pairs, but this system had become lax, as Skywalker and Solo had demonstrated. Now, scouts were strictly ordered to stay together. That night, one sentry, [[Bervin]], was attacked by another wampa. He commed the command center, but they heard only his screams before the creature tore him apart. Bevin's call was followed by similar ones from other perimeter posts. Before the base could organize a team to investigate, a whole clan of wampas smashed through an ice wall to enter Echo Base. They attacked anyone in their way in their effort to defend their territory. The Rebels fought off the creatures, bringing in heavy artillery when their weapons proved ineffective. Finally R2-D2 found that astromech droids like himself could produce a high-pitched sound that wampas could not tolerate. The base's astromechs managed to drive some wampas away, while others were stunned and incapacitated. These were gathered into shielded pens deeper in the base.{{WEGCite|story=The Horror By Night|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back}} ===Probing eye of the Empire=== {{Dialogue|Leia|An Imperial probe droid.|Han|It's a good bet the Empire knows we're here.|Rieekan|We'd better start the evacuation.|attr=Leia Organa, Han Solo, and Carlist Rieekan after the probe self-destructed|src=|audio=Organa-Solo-Rieekan.flac}} Meanwhile, the Imperial probe droid that Skywalker had mistaken for a meteor lost no time in tracing the commander's comlink signal to its likely point of origin. While Skywalker recovered, the droid made its way toward the base. After climbing over a rise in [[Zone Twelve/Legends|Zone Twelve]], it detected Echo Base's large [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]]. It transmitted an image and key data to the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],{{WEGCite|story=The Probing Eye of the Empire|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back}} the flagship of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], whose hunt for the Rebel base, and for his [[Parent/Legends|son]] Luke Skywalker in particular, had become an obsession. The probot began to map the outer defenses of the base, including the surrounding trenches, artillery, the anti-orbital ion cannon, and [[Troop/Legends|troop]] movements and positions. Before it could do anything else, a [[Unidentified Rebel trooper (Station 3-8)|Rebel scout trooper]] positioned in [[Echo Station 3-8]] detected it. The droid opened fire and destroyed the outpost before the trooper could report what he had seen. General Rieekan summoned Solo and Organa from Skywalker's bedside to the command center. All he could tell them was that a metallic movement had been detected outside Zone Twelve, along with an audio signal unfamiliar to the Alliance. Solo and Chewbacca left the base to investigate to the probe droid's signal. When they found the droid, Solo fired at it, triggering its [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]]. When Rieekan heard Solo's report, he concluded that the Imperials had found them. He ordered the evacuation of Echo Base. The probe droid's transmission reached the ''Executor'' in the [[Qeimet system/Legends|Qeimet system]], where Captain [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] reported it to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]]. The admiral dismissed it as an uncharted settlement, but Vader overrode him, confident that the Rebel base and Skywalker were indeed on Hoth. He ordered them to set course for the Hoth system and for General [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] to prepare his troops. ===The Battle of Hoth=== ====A bleak evacuation==== {{Quote|All troop carriers will assemble at the north entrance. The heavy transport ships will leave as soon as they're loaded. Only two fighter escorts per ship. The energy shield can only be opened for a short time, so you'll have to stay very close to your transports.|Leia Organa to the assembled pilots|audio=LeiaBriefing-ESB.flac|}} [[File:EchoBase-MSWC40.png|thumb|right|300px|T-47 snowspeeders patrol the exterior of Echo Base.]] The Rebels prepared their evacuation. Knowing that the Imperial fleet would arrive quickly, they had to abandon much of their heavy equipment. As the first transports began lifting off, they prepared for the coming attack. The ground troops were to fight a delaying action that would give the other personnel time for [[Code 1-5]]—the final evacuation of the base.''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' Rebel Campaign. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]] predicted correctly that Imperials would make the above-ground shield generator their main target, so he placed troops in a way that would funnel the enemy in that direction and away from the staging area for the transports. The troop placements created a bottleneck in which the Imperials would be massed together and vulnerable to attack by the snowspeeders of Rogue Group. Solo and Chewbacca now rushed to repair the ''Falcon'' in time. As they struggled, a recovered Skywalker approached them to say his farewells. Just then the Imperial fleet suddenly came out of [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] in [[Sector Four (Hoth system)/Legends|Sector Four]], close to Hoth and highly visible, alerting the Rebels in the command center. Rieekan diverted power to the base's energy shield to protect from bombardment and ordered the Rebels to prepare for a ground assault. For this tactical error, Vader summarily executed Ozzel. He ordered the newly promoted Admiral Piett to land the Imperial troops outside of the energy shield while the fleet blockaded Hoth to prevent Rebel starships from leaving the system. In Hangar Bay 7, Organa briefed an assembly of [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilots]] for the upcoming [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]. The plan was for the energy shield to be opened briefly to allow one Rebel transport and two fighter escorts to depart the base at a time. The ion cannon was to fire on the Imperial Star Destroyers to ensure the safe passage of the Rebel ships, which would then proceed to [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Haven]], their rendezvous point. As the first transport left Hoth, the ion cannon fired at the Star Destroyer [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], successfully deactivating it. The transport's safe passage was announced over Echo Base's intercom, drawing cheers from the evacuating Rebels. The pilots prepared to fly out of the base. Skywalker flew a snowspeeder as [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] with [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] serving as his [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]]. Under heavy [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighter]] escort, [[Dropship/Legends|dropships]] deployed the troops and vehicles of [[Blizzard Force/Legends|Blizzard Force]] past the edge of the deflector shield on a vast glacial field north of Echo Base. The Rebel fighters of [[Grey Squadron]] opposed their landing, taking out some TIEs and landing craft. The first Rebel to spot the incoming [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]] was Corporal [[Maren Kelsome]], mounted on a tauntaun at [[Outpost Beta/Legends|Outpost Beta]]. He notified the troopers at Echo Station 3-T-8 of the approaching walkers on the [[North Ridge/Legends|North Ridge]]. [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Trey Callum/Legends|Trey Callum]] reported the sighting back to Echo Base. Within the base, the thudding of the walkers was soon felt as pieces of snow dislodged from the roof and hit R2-D2. The AT-ATs began firing at the outlying stations. As Imperial troops approached Echo Station 5-7, Corporal Jobin called for air support; Skywalker received and responded to his call, and Rogue Squadron now flew towards the Imperial forces. Blizzard Force continued its inexorable advance, and Rebel forces at each station and entrenchment fell back just before their positions were overrun. They knew that they could neither repulse nor stop the attack, only delay it. As Veers fought his way closer to the shield generator in his AT-AT, [[Blizzard 1/Legends|''Blizzard 1'']], he reported his location to Vader, allowing the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to land on Hoth. Vader's [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] were first deployed on the ground to capture an outlook command post, followed by a forward bunker. [[File:AndNobodyImportantWasHurt-ESBHD.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Han Solo enters the damaged command center to escort Leia Organa to safety.]] Rogue Squadron was able to bring down several of the advancing AT-ATs. [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], a mercenary who was stuck at the base, joined the operation and performed well at the helm of one of the speeders. The Imperials deployed additional forces via [[Sentinel-class landing craft/Legends|''Sentinel''-class landing craft]] near a Rebel defense bunker.''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Renegade Squadron]]'' Inside the command center, Organa insisted that time was running out and they had to start sending two transports at once, despite Rieekan's concern that the Rebels could not protect them. She then ordered the evacuation of the remaining ground staff. In Hangar 7, the remaining small craft prepared to leave, since every speeder pilot would be required to also fly as a starfighter escort. As R2-D2 loaded himself into Skywalker's [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]], C-3PO warned the astromech droid to be cautious. Solo and Chewbacca's work on the ''Falcon'' continued, panic rising. A blast damaged Echo Base's command center. When word of this reached Solo, he went to retrieve Organa and ensure that she was safely aboard the final Rebel transport. Organa maintained her command, ordering troops in [[Sector Twelve/Legends|Sector Twelve]] to protect fighters in the south slope. ====Imperial victory==== {{Quote|Imperial troops have entered the base. Imperial troops have— ''[''static'']''|Grond, over the Echo Base intercom|}} Blizzard Force continued to advance. Its walkers destroyed the fortress and other defensive structures. The first breach of the base itself occurred in the ion cannon control bunker. Imperial snowtroopers entered, killed the crew, and took control of the cannon. The Rebels were unaware of the attack until one of them spotted an AT-ST and several snowtroopers approaching the cannon on the south ridge and reported it to Jobin. The corporal led a team of four other troopers, including [[Roj]], [[Grond (Rebel)|Grond]], [[Sora]], and [[Unidentified Rebel trooper (Hoth)|another trooper]], towards the cannon, where Jobin destroyed the AT-ST with an explosive package. Jobin's troops entered the ion cannon control center and attacked the five snowtroopers inside. Two of the rebels were killed, including Grond as he grabbed an intercom to announce that Imperial troops had entered Echo Base. Following the announcement, Organa ordered a subordinate to release the evacuation code signal, beginning the retreat of the remaining ground troops. She was then grabbed by Solo and they ran for the last transport. Meanwhile another force of troopers and scout walkers threatened Hangar Bay 7. The Rebel operative [[X2]] led the defense the hangar and then rushed an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2]] droid to the ion cannon control bunker to conduct repairs. There, Jobin was forced to stab a snowtrooper in the [[Eye/Legends|eye]] with an icicle in order to fire the ion cannon, saving two of the Rebel transports. He and his two surviving companions then set the cannon to self-destruct and ran for Hangar Bay 7. [[File:EchoBaseCavern.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An interior cavern housing Rebellion equipment]] ''Blizzard 1'' then destroyed the base's power generator. Solo and Organa's passage to the last transport was blocked when falling rubble covered their passageway, so Solo to took Organa back to the ''Millennium Falcon'' in Hangar Bay 7, trailed by C-3PO. While most of Veers's troops moved into position around the perimeter to block all routes of escape, Vader and the 501st entered the base. The fleeing C-3PO heard troops just behind him and thought to remove the warning sign from one of the rooms where captive wampas were being held. The troops broke through the locked door only to be torn apart by the creatures, who then tore through the walls to leave the base.{{WEGCite|story=One Step Ahead|book=Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back (Second Edition)}} Vader and the troops with him moved toward the hangar bay just behind Solo, Organa, C-3PO, and Chewbacca. As the snowtroopers caught up, Solo activated an hidden turret on the ''Millennium Falcon'', killing several of them. The ''Falcon'' flew out of the hangar just as Vader arrived. Skywalker, returning on foot to his X-Wing after his snowspeeder had been shot down, saw the freighter escape. Any Rebel personnel still in the base scrambled to whatever craft they could find. Rendar raced through Hangar Bay 7 just as the ''Falcon'' took off; he had to fight his way to the base's emergency generator in order to open the door to [[Bay 3]] where his freighter sat. Jobin and two of his companions entered Hangar Bay 7 immediately afterward—Vader ordered his troops to take them and so the Rebels sprinted to [[Hangar Ten]]. As the trio reached a Y-Wing, Jobin was shot down by the snowtroopers, but was able to pass along a recording he had made for his mother: Alliance Head of State [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]]. Vader then killed the corporal with a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choke]]. X2 fled to his fighter, which he had left outside the base. He joined Grey Squadron in a daring attack against the Star Destroyer ''[[Audacious]]''. Skywalker and the other surviving Rogue pilots entered their X-Wing fighters to escort the final transports past the blockade. Skywalker himself departed for the [[Dagobah system/Legends|Dagobah system]]. The 501st continued fighting their way through the base, destroying a panel in the command center to access the rear hangar, where a GR75 transport was loading. A trooper placed a beacon, allowing a Star Destroyer to launch an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] at the spot, destroying the transport and its defenders. While the ion cannon set to explode failed to self-destruct, most of the central base was destroyed by the Rebel special operations group [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], who set explosive charges all around it. Despite heavy losses on the ground and the loss of several transports, most of the personnel of Echo Base were able to escape, along with a good deal of valuable equipment and materiel. They regrouped at the rendezvous point of [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Haven]]. ===Echoes of war=== {{Quote|Here during the battle of Hoth is where I learned to be a warrior. I left the wreckage of Echo Base to find Yoda, and one of the first things he told me was that wars don't make a person great.|Luke Skywalker, to Callista Ming|[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]}} After the battle and evacuation, Echo Base was left in a ruined state. Days after the battle, the salvager and [[Arms dealer/Legends|arms dealer]] [[Arns Grimraker]] visited the ruins looking for anything he could sell.{{CSWECite|I|370|Grimraker, Arns}} Owing to a grudge against the Rebellion, he also planned to destroy whatever was left of the base as a message to the survivors. Wedge Antilles and Wes Janson returned to the base at the same time. A fight broke out that left Grimraker dead. The two Rebel pilots later spun the event into a wild story that they told recruits. A [[4 ABY/Legends|year and several months later]], the ruins were made a tour destination for one of the travel packages for the travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]].[[Star Tours (real-world)|''Star Tours'']] Years later, a former stormtrooper named [[Burrk]] and a pair of [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] twin brothers, [[Nodon]] and [[Nonak]], began making expeditions to Hoth to illegally [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] wampas. To get funding, they quietly promoted their trips to wealthy big-game hunters. They camped in the ruins of Echo Base, making one-day excursions to hunt the creatures in the surrounding wild. They made two successful expeditions. On their third trip in [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the hunters found that their would-be quarry had learned to work together. A huge group of wampas killed three of the four paying clients in the hunting party and tore apart their ship where it sat outside the base. The survivors holed up in the deserted base while the enraged creatures waited outside. They managed to get pair of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] online outside the shield door and rigged them to [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensors]] to fire at the creatures, but with no supplies, no ship, and no way to contact anyone, they had little hope of escape. Luke Skywalker and his love [[Callista Ming]] found the hunters there; the couple were trying to retrace places where Luke had experienced life-changing encounters with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in an attempt to help Callista recover her lost [[Force power/Legends|Jedi powers]]. The automated blasters at the entrance nearly killed them until Luke disabled them with his lightsaber. The Jedi and the hunters spoke inside and decided to risk venturing back out to send a [[Distress signal/Legends|distress signal]]. As they moved, the wampas attacked. They fled back inside, but the creatures now broke into the base, attacking as a well-coordinated killing team. The hunters were all killed. As Luke and Callista ran to their ship, Luke realized to his horror that the creatures were led by the one-armed wampa whom he had fought nine years earlier. The old enemies recognized one another, and this time, Luke cut her in half. He and Callista barely escaped with their lives. [[File:Wellguardedpileofjunk.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The entrance to Echo Base ruins in 14 ABY]] In [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]], an [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] force occupied the ruins of Echo Base. Hoping to discover the location of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] in the working segments of the Alliance computer core, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] devotees of the [[Disciples of Ragnos]] and their Imperial subordinates dug an entrance to the base underneath the hulk of a fallen AT-AT. However, their activities [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|were discovered]] by [[Jaden Korr]]. The young Jedi destroyed the force of [[Cold assault stormtrooper|snowtroopers]] and [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-ST]] walkers and chased off the Sith acolytes. He dueled [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Alora (Dark Jedi)|Alora]] and defeated her, but she fled, promising to encounter him again in the future. During Jaden's exploration of the frozen ruins of Echo base, he discovered the firing control room of the ion cannon, from which the still-intact cannon itself could be seen. Although no longer capable of tracking a target, the cannon still drew power from its reactors and was capable of firing. ==Personnel== {{Quote|These troops stood staunchly against the odds, meeting an unstoppable Imperial force with grim determination and unswerving loyalty typical of Rebel forces. |[[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]]|}} [[File:Wilderness_Fighters_TDOH.png|thumb|left|200px|SpecForce troopers in cold-weather gear]] The number of people stationed in Echo Base fluctuated constantly, but at its height, it housed approximately 7,500 combat and command personnel. One thousand of these were [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|SpecForce]] troopers trained in cold-weather combat, many of them from the [[Wilderness Fighters]] regiments.{{FFGTCG|set=The Desolation of Hoth|cardname=Wilderness Fighters}} As Hoth had become the seat of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], around 1,000 officials and functionaries of the [[Alliance Civil Government/Legends|Alliance Civil Government]] were stationed there. In addition, there were 350 medical personnel, 120 [[Droid/Legends|droids]], and thousands of support staff: supply clerks, [[Technician/Legends|techs]], cooks, and others. During Echo Base's initial construction, it was led by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Kem Monnon/Legends|Kem Monnon]], head of the [[Alliance Corps of Engineers/Legends|Alliance Corps of Engineers]]. After this phase was complete, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Carlist Rieekan/Legends|Carlist Rieekan]] held overall command of the base. An [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] veteran of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Rieekan had been in the [[Alderaan system/Legends|Alderaan system]] when the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]] approached. Rieekan had witnessed its arrival but feared that ordering a mass evacuation would provoke an attack. He had chosen to do nothing before the battle station opened fire and [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destroyed the planet]]. Rieekan was still haunted by his decision when he was given command of all Rebel forces at Hoth, and his top priority was making sure that the people under him had a plan of escape in the event that the Empire discovered Echo Base. Assisting Rieekan was a circle of advisors and officers. First among them was his fellow Alderaanian, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]. Organa was a member of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] and Rieekan deferred to her on many matters. She was actively involved in the running of the base; she co-directed meetings of base staff and conducted briefings. At times Organa served in [[Echo Command Center]], which was overseen by Chief Controller [[Toryn Farr/Legends|Toryn Farr]].{{StoryCite|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM}} Rieekan handpicked Major [[Bren Derlin/Legends|Bren Derlin]] to lead the base's security and operations. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Ledick Firest/Legends|Ledick Firest]], a former [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] of the [[Laramus Base Irregulars]], was the [[Field Commander/Legends|field commander]] of the base's ground forces, responsible for directing the defenses in the event of an attack. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Tamizander Rey]] oversaw docking bay operations as the ranking [[Deck officer/Legends|deck officer]],{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Tamizander Rey}} assisted by officers including [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenants]] [[Nela Arseli]] and [[Romas Navander/Legends|"Lock" Navander]], the latter of whom relayed orders to pilots from the command center.{{CCG|set=Hoth Limited|cardname=Romas "Lock" Navander}} [[File:TheFateofAllFemaleWookieepedians.png|thumb|right|300px|Leia organa briefs the pilots of Echo Base just before the evacuation.]] At first, the ranking [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] was Commander [[Arhul Narra/Legends|"Boss" Narra]], whose [[Renegade Flight]] of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] escorted supply runs to the base. After Narra was killed in the [[Battle of Derra IV]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was promoted to Commander and became the leader of Echo Base's pilots, most of whom flew under him as members of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Group]]. Skywalker directed the Rogues' training in Echo Base's newly-converted [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeders]]. One of the base's top field officers, Skywalker also oversaw [[Tauntaun/Legends|tauntaun]] scouting patrols and, with [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], was directing the construction of a network of regional warning sensors. Skywalker's Rogues became Alliance legends after the Battle of Hoth. His next in command was [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who took charge of the Rogues after the battle and built them into a full squadron. Other Rogue pilots included [[Derek Klivian/Legends|"Hobbie" Klivian]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], [[Tarrin Datch/Legends|Tarrin Datch]], and [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]], all of whom survived the battle; alongside others like [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]], [[Tenk Lenso]], and [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]] who were killed in action. A third starfighter unit, the small but seasoned [[Grey Squadron]], flew under the leadership of the [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[X2]]. A close friend of Skywalker and Organa, Captain Solo was also a high-ranking field officer whom Rieekan consulted for advice. He was the co-commander of [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], an elite fighting unit made of former [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and other [[Fringer/Legends|fringers]] recruited from the Galaxy's underworld. Solo shared command of the unit with Commander [[Col Serra]]. From Echo Base, the Renegades launched attacks against the Empire. Serra and his Renegades distinguished themselves during the evacuation and were the last unit out of the base. Commander Narra's [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[K-3PO/Legends|K-3PO]], held a position of leadership in his own right. In his long career the droid had acquired a wealth of tactical knowledge, and this was put to use in the command center and in the position of [[Supervisor droid/Legends|coordinator]] of the entire droid labor pool. [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]], an [[Manumission/Legends|emancipated droid]] who had joined the Rebellion at his own initiative, had the position of chief of surgery in the [[Echo Base medical center/Legends|Echo Base medical center]]. Several notable Rebels served at Echo Base outside of the top leadership. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] were famous [[Heroes of Yavin/Legends|Heroes of Yavin]]. Chewbacca mainly continued in his role as Solo's copilot and spent the bulk of his time trying to repair their freighter, the ''[[Millennium Falcon/Legends|Millennium Falcon]]''. The droid [[Counterpart/Legends|counterparts]] were proud of their status as personal aides to Organa and Skywalker; they took offense whenever K-3PO assigned them to other duties. [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Jobin]], despite being the son of the Alliance's [[Chief of State (Alliance)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], was assigned to Echo Base as an ordinary trooper in charge of the [[4th Squad]]. He was killed late in the battle by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself. Historian [[Voren Na'al/Legends|Voren Na'al]] was assigned to observe and document the events at Echo Base, and in the course of this work he performed various other menial jobs. As resupply grew difficult, Echo Base was forced to hire independent smugglers at expensive rates. One of these, [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], was at the base at the time of the Imperial attack and volunteered to fly a snowspeeder alongside the Rogue pilots.''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'' ==Behind the scenes== ===''The Empire Strikes Back''=== Echo Base was created for the [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']],''[[Creating the Worlds of Star Wars: 365 Days]]'' which was released on [[May 21]], [[1980]].''[[Star Wars Year by Year: A Visual Chronicle]]'' However, the base made its actual first appearance in the film's [[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (novelization)|novelization]], which was written by [[Donald F. He was easily two months, maybe three months behind. Every time I saw him I said, 'Stanley, you've got to get off that stage. I have a set to build.' And he said, 'Just a few more days. I've got to finish up a few things.'|Gary Kurtz, on his interactions with Stanley Kubrick|''[[The Star Wars Archives: Episodes IV–VI, 1977–1983]]''}} [[File:Hangar7set-ElstreeStudios-Archives4-6.png|thumb|left|300px|The set for Hangar 7 under construction on Stage 6 at Elstree Studios]] The sets for the Echo Base scenes were built at [[Elstree Studios]]. Construction of the sets was delayed by several months, as a catastrophic fire destroyed the "Colorado Lounge" set for director [[Wikipedia:Stanley Kubrick|Stanley Kubrick's]] film [[Wikipedia:The Shining (film)|''The Shining'']] on [[January 24]], [[1979]], putting the filming for the movie behind. The original plan was for ''The Shining'' to wrap up filming by [[February 1]] and for the ''Empire'' team to move in and build the sixty-four sets needed for the film, but the fire meant Kubrick's team did not know when they would be finished. During the final months of filming for ''The Shining'', [[Gary Kurtz]] reminded Kubrick that he needed to finish every time he saw the director, as Kurtz had sets to build. Kubrick assured him he only needed a few more days, having a few things that needed to be wrapped up. When construction finally started, the set for the hangar was constructed on Stage 6 and was so large that a special stage, known as the "''Star Wars'' Stage" was built. The stage measured seventy-six meters long, thirty-seven meters wide, and fourteen meters high, and had a total capacity of 35,000 cubic meters.{{DB|location|echobase|Echo Base}} The control room and medical room sets were constructed on Stage 1, with the bacta tank used to heal Skywalker being three feet in diameter. ====Filming==== {{Quote|Temperament determines everything. Rhythm is a part of that, an extension of temperament. I move the camera more than George, and set up a scene much differently. My staging—the way the people move—is more lyrical.|Director Irvin Kershner|}} [[File:SolorealizesLukesintrouble-filming-Archives4-6.png|thumb|300px||right|The scene where Solo realizes Skywalker is in danger being filmed with multiple cameras]] On [[March 13]], 1979, the main unit filmed a scene in the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} main hold while the ship was in the base's hangar. Slate 205 for the scene covered the master scene and included three takes, two of which were printed. Slate 205A covered the end of the scene, with two of the six takes printed, and slate 205B covered the beginning of the scene, using two cameras, with one getting a close-up of Leia's face and the other a close-up of Chewbacca's. The scene included ad-libbed dialogue, and two of the six takes were printed. Slate 205C captured the master scene with two cameras, with two different close-ups of Solo. Two takes from both cameras were considered good enough to print. In the end, Kershner presented eleven takes from scene 205 to be cut together. [[File:Lukebactamaskfilming-Archives4-6.png|thumb|300px|left|A medical droid peels gauze of Skywalker's face, with screenwriter Lawrence Kasdan in the center of the shot.]] While filming Solo entering the hangar on his tauntaun after returning from patrol, the crew created the sensation of movement by the tauntaun by rotating the camera around the immovable puppet. During the scene where Solo approaches Chewbacca while the latter is repairing the ''Millennium Falcon'', Ford recited, "I'll take a good fight any day over all this hidin' and freezin'!" The line was not included in the final cut of the film. The scene where Solo realizes Skywalker might be in serious trouble was filmed using multiple cameras. The control scenes were shot at Stage 1 late in [[March]] [[1979]]. The medical room scenes were also shot at Stage 1, and a wet-suited stuntman was used to check if the bacta tank was in working order. An insert was shot including a medical droid peeling gauze off Skywalker's face. The hangar scenes were filmed by the film's main and second unit from [[May 22]]–[[June 6]], 1979. To make the hangar look bigger than it actually was, children were dressed as Rebel pilots and soldiers and placed in the background of shots. =====Wampa attack===== {{Quote|The sequence with the wampas in the Rebel base never made it into the final cut. It seemed like: 'Let's give R2-D2 and C-3PO something to do while these other things are happening…'"
"'…otherwise we'll forget them.' Once we cut it together, we realized that there was so much going on that we didn't really need it.|Film historian Paul Duncan and George Lucas|}} [[File:Wampaattackdeleted-Archives4-6.png|thumb|right|200px|A wampa attack on Echo Base was filmed before being cut.]] The first draft of the film's script included a scene in which wampas attacked Echo Base in an attempt to reclaim their territory. In the scene, the creatures infiltrate the base through an intricate tunnel network, and a wampa breaks through and throws Rebels around after attacking a snowtrooper before being killed by a [[Missile launcher/Legends|bazooka]]. Although the Imperial attack was the primary focus, the wampa attack was considered the main threat and remained in the shooting script, which reduced the scale of the attack to a couple of scenes featuring R2-D2 and the Rebels prior to Imperial forces marching on the base. At the beginning of the scene, the wampas were mysterious figures in the background, meant to create a tense atmosphere reminiscent of the [[1950s|1951]] film [[Wikipedia:The Thing from Another World|''The Thing from Another World'']] as evidenced by a shot of R2-D2 with a wampa visible in the distance. Also in the original shooting script, a tauntaun was killed when a wampa stormed into Echo Base.''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]'' The scene was shot by the second unit over six days in [[April]] 1979 and took fifteen setups to complete. The Daily Shooting Logs for [[April 2]]–[[April 3|3]], 1979, show the difficulties of filming setups 44, 44A, and 44B. Setup 44, which was shot on Monday, April 2, took ten takes, with only the last two being labeled for printing, though the ninth take had stuck eye movement. The first take's action was considered too slow; the third take was cut due to the operator; the fifth take was cut due to a "snow stick" entering the shot; the sixth take was considered good for snow and the approach but was cut near the end for head action; the seventh take was considered fair; and the eigth take was cut for slow eye movement despite being considered quite good. The setup was filmed on a single camera and lasted 15 seconds. The full shot features R2-D2 approaching the camera from a corridor in the background where Rebel troops are working, with two additional Rebels crossing from left to right in front of the droid in the foreground before snow falls. R2 turns his head and continues on until another batch of snow falls on his head. He looks from camera left to camera right and then all around before moving forward into the lens and out of focus. [[File:Wampaicewall-deletedscene-TESB.gif|thumb|left|300px|The ice wall frequently failed to give way enough for Des Webb to break through in the wampa costume.]] Setup 44A was actually the first shot filmed for the day. In the setup, R2-D2 moves through an ice tunnel when a wampa smashes out of the wall. As four cameras were poised for the action, actor [[Des Webb]] did not have enough leverage to knock through, resulting in no usable takes. The first two takes were cut before action even started, the third was cut as R2-D2 moved away, and the fourth was cut as the droid moved away due to the ice wall not coming down. Filming for 44A was halted and resumed the following day, where take 5 was not completed due to the wall once again not giving way sufficiently for the ice monster to break through. Setup 44B was also filmed that day, using four cameras and four takes. The setup lasted 8 seconds, and all four takes were printed, though the first three from only specific cameras: take 1 had too much steam, which obscured visibility of the ice monster, and so only the footage from the C camera was printed; R2-D2 hit the corner of a wall in the foreground in take 2, and so only footage from D camera was printed; the doors hit R2-D2 as they closed on take 3, and so only footage from the B and C cameras was printed; and take 4 was considered very good, with all four cameras having footage printed. [[File:Outside_the_Wampa_pen.jpg|thumb|right|300px|One deleted scene showed C-3PO tearing a warning sign off the door to a wampa pen.]] Another sequence was filmed showing C-3PO tearing a warning sign off a door of a wampa pen, with a group of snowtroopers following behind and entering the pen and being attacked by a wampa, then closing the door trapping one of their comrades inside. Darth Vader enters the shot and chooses to walk away instead of helping."Deleted Scene: Wampa Attack" on [[Disney+]] However, these scenes, and the entire wampa attack altogether, were later deleted and did not make the final version of the film. According to film historian [[Paul Duncan]] and [[George Lucas]], the purpose of the scene was to include moments featuring R2-D2 and C-3PO so the audience would not forget them, but after cutting it together, they realized so much else was happening that the scene was not needed. Problems with the scene put production an additional two days behind schedule. ===Interactive retellings=== ====''Shadows of the Empire''==== {{Quote|Actually, when people talk about artificial intelligence in computer games, most of the time it isn't really intelligent–I like to call it 'artificial stupidity.'|Mark Haigh-Hutchinson, Project leader and supervisor of the Battle of Hoth level on ''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire''|''[[The Secrets of Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]''}} [[File:Knoles-BattleofHoth-SecretsofSOTE.png|thumb|right|300px|Jon Knoles created the computer-generated models used in the Battle of Hoth level of ''Shadows of the Empire''.]] Echo Base appeared in the first two levels of the [[1997]] [[LucasArts]] video game [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (video game)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' video game]], titled "Battle of Hoth" and "Escape from Echo Base." For the team at LucasArts, the opportunity to utilize the [[Nintendo|Nintendo 64]] console to represent the Battle of Hoth was irresistible. ''Shadows of the Empire'' thus became the first real-time, interactive 3-D recreation of the iconic battle. The game studio's enthusiasm for staging action between snowspeeders and walkers was the reason the battle was included as a chapter in the life of the game's main character, Dash Rendar. An early internal game outline document dated to [[April 17]], [[1995]], which described the challenge LucasArts wanted to create for the player/character in the first level, stated the objective of the level as, "Give Rebels time to escape Echo Base." [[Jon Knoles]] created computer-generated models of All Terrain Scout Transport walkers and the ''Outrider'', Rendar's ship, in Echo Base. Project leader [[Mark Haigh-Hutchinson]] supervised the development of the Battle of Hoth level and programmed the artificial intelligence of the player opponents in the level. When describing the layout of the level, Haigh-Hutchinson stated they wanted a measure of predictability to allow the player to progress and improve while balancing it with an element of randomness so the player did not feel the game was set in stone. ====''Galactic Battlegrounds''==== The [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' shows two different versions of Echo Base, one in the Darth Vader campaign and the other in the Leia Organa campaign. ====Non-canon video game depictions==== In the [[2006]] [[Canon|non-canonical]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'', the Battle of Hoth and Solo and Organa's escape from the base is adapted with differences than how it is portrayed in the film.''[[LEGO Star Wars II: The Original Trilogy]]'' In an alternate, non-canonical DLC of the 2009 videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition]]'', [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]], a newly appointed apprentice to [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]]' is sent to the base to intercept the escaping rebels, following the Battle of Hoth. After successfully infiltrating the base, Starkiller eventually confronts Luke Skywalker in the hangar housing the ''Millennium Falcon''. As the fighting goes on, Skywalker eventually gives in to the dark side. However, he still loses to Starkiller and loses his hand. As the Millennium Falcon moves to escape, Starkiller stops the ship with the Force. He tells Luke that only the dark side can save his friends. Faced with this, Luke attacks Starkiller with red force lightning. Starkiller blocks Skywalker's attack and releases the Falcon. Starkiller declares the now yellow-eyed Luke his apprentice.''[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Ultimate Sith Edition]]'' ===Inconsistencies=== The [[1993]] video game ''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' depicts a small Rebel installation called [[Gamma Base]] on an ice planet before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The gameplay closely parallels the events that occurred years later at Echo Base: Gamma Base is discovered by probe droids, attacked by Imperial walkers, defended by snowspeeders, and finally evacuated. The game itself does not identify Gamma Base's location, but some accompanying materials say that it is on Hoth.''[[Star Wars: Rebel Assault]]'' This contradicts all other depictions of how the Rebels discovered, occupied, and evacuated Hoth, including in the film ''The Empire Strikes Back.'' ''[[Galaxy Guide 3: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' published in [[1989]], includes the story "[[The Horror By Night]]." This story adapts the events of the wampa attack in the scene deleted from ''The Empire Strikes Back.'' It emphasizes that the personnel of Echo Base had not encountered any wampas before Luke Skywalker was attacked out on patrol. This contradicts both earlier and later sources that state that the Rebels knew about wampas and encountered them during the early phase of construction. This article assumes that the attack happened as described, but that the story is in error when it describes it as their first encounter with the creatures. [[Star Wars (1977) 78|Issue 78]] of the [[Star Wars (1977)|Marvel ''Star Wars'']] comic, written in [[1983]], has Wedge Antilles tell a story of being stranded on Hoth with Wes Janson after the battle. This contradicts both earlier{{ESBRadio|The Millennium Falcon Pursuit}} and later portrayals in which both of them evacuate with Rogue Squadron. The article series ''[[Hoth: Under the Ice]]'', published on [[Wizards.com]] in [[2003]], confirms that only some events from the comic really happened, and the rest was a tall tale that Wedge would tell recruits for his own amusement. However, the same article series introduces another inconsistency: in describing [[Mission to Hoth (Jaden Korr)|Jaden Korr's mission to Hoth]], it states that Korr's master [[Kyle Katarn]] also traveled to the ruins of Echo Base. This contradicts the mission's original appearance in the game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]],'' released earlier that same year.
